name: Accountability & Integrity
description: Demonstrates honesty, responsibility, ethical behaviour, ownership of decisions, and commitment to organizational values.

name: Resilience & Stress Management
description: Maintains emotional stability, adapts under pressure, recovers from setbacks, and performs effectively during challenging situations.

name: Leadership & Influence
description: Inspires, motivates, influences others, and provides clear direction toward achieving organizational goals.

name: Delegation & Team Empowerment
description: Effectively delegates responsibilities, develops team capability, builds trust, and empowers employees.

name: Emotional Intelligence & Empathy
description: Recognizes emotions, demonstrates empathy, builds positive relationships, and manages interpersonal interactions effectively.

name: Communication & Feedback
description: Communicates clearly, listens actively, provides constructive feedback, and encourages open dialogue.

name: Strategic Thinking & Vision
description: Thinks long-term, aligns actions with organizational strategy, anticipates future challenges, and creates vision.

name: Conflict Resolution
description: Addresses disagreements professionally, resolves conflicts fairly, and promotes collaboration.

name: Decision Making & Problem Solving
description: Analyzes information, evaluates alternatives, solves problems systematically, and makes sound decisions.

name: Adaptability & Change Management
description: Accepts change, learns quickly, remains flexible, and effectively manages organizational transitions.
